endermagnolia-v0.0.1.description:
The first pre-release of the **Archipelago** world for **Ender Magnolia** is now available.

## Requirements
- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases)
- [Ender Magnolia Randomizer](https://github.com/Trexounay/EnderMagnolia.Randomizer/releases)

## Current Features
- 297 checks
- 1 Goal: **Ending A**
- Starting Skill option

## Planned Features
- Shop integration
- Currency support
- Additional options:
  - Ending B goal
  - Minimum/maximum chapter settings

## Notes

This is an early pre-release and has not been extensively tested. Expect bugs and missing features, and please report any issues or feedback.
endermagnolia-v0.0.1.title: Ender Magnolia World v0.0.1 (Pre-release)
